warnings: Official-source consultation does not license shrine or Kyoto Travel photographs, maps, page layouts, logos, text passages, donor inscriptions, or trade dress.

Fushimi Inari Taisha prohibits commercial photography without permission. That rule does not itself decide original-illustration rights, but commercial release still requires destination-specific legal and cultural review.
No shrine endorsement, permission, private-interior access, overnight use, or special lighting program is claimed.
Check accidental similarity, local site-use expectations, and any applicable trademark, unfair-competition, or cultural-property concerns before promotion.
Treat the shrine as an active sacred place of worship, not a theme-park corridor or costume set.
Keep worshipper circulation open and do not stage people, a Portrait slot, or props on gates, lanterns, worship structures, or restricted areas.
Do not invent sacred motifs, rites, offerings, festival elements, or access to private or sacred interiors.
Keep torii donor inscriptions blank and omit readable or pseudo-text.
The sheltered sleep slot is compositional fiction and does not imply that sleeping at the shrine or Teichoan is permitted.
Animals and fox imagery are omitted rather than using sacred associations decoratively.
